name: C2 failure root cause retained
why: Preserve rejected C2 and exact P003/P006 collision proof.

name: C2R1 native CAD + assembly + interference
why: Build, mate architecture and no-new-hard-interference are the geometry release gate.

name: Pilot tolerance chain + P006 service-tool envelope
why: Nominal 0.25 mm radial clearance is proven only at nominal geometry. Freeze P006 head tolerance, pilot-ID tolerance, worst-case clearance and tool access.

name: Seal compound + clamp preload
why: O-ring geometry exists, but compound/hardness/process-gas compatibility and compression force are needed before clamp preload is released.

name: M2.5 joint + local flange/contact verification
why: Preliminary thread screen does not reject M2.5; final preload/friction/head-bearing/flange-separation verification remains.

name: Thermal preload + service/galling
why: Quantify preload drift, stainless galling/anti-seize policy, loosening and repeated service cycles.

name: P007 static + buckling refresh
why: Historical pressure/buckling screens must be refreshed once C2R1 mechanical geometry/preload is frozen.

name: C2R1 BOM normalization / metadata projection
why: Assembly quantities are known; 13 metadata projections and 7 release blockers remain in the current reconciliation.

name: Production-capable drawing draft
why: A file existing is not enough. The drawing quality gate requires section, visible dimensions, title block and controlled callouts.

name: Final FEMM impact/release model
why: Run after J2 mechanical freeze plus P015/B001 production data freeze.

name: Atomic P003/P007 promotion / release audit
why: Promote P003/P007 together only after all mandatory engineering gates and document/BOM controls pass.
